text: The retrieved works do not directly address interventions targeting detection of AI-generated content or recognition of authentic content as distinct outcomes. The closest prior findings come from the inoculation and prebunking literature, which demonstrates that proactive interventions can improve people's resistance to misinformation (Lewandowsky & van der Linden, 2021; Lewandowsky et al., 2017), though these studies measured belief resistance rather than binary detection accuracy for AI-generated versus authentic items. No retrieved work reports findings on interventions that differentially affect detection of AI-generated content versus recognition of authentic content, leaving H2 and H3 without direct prior evidence in this set.
